name: Valga Cromwell
original_name: バルガ・クロムウェル
source:
A member of Felt Camp whom Felt calls "Old Man Rom". He has taken care of Felt for a long time. Rom is a good-natured giant, with honest intentions when it comes to evaluating trinkets. He is a known alcoholic and frequents the enjoyments of drinking. When it comes to strangers, he isn't afraid of them, and he has a high awareness when it comes to sensing hostility.

[From [url=https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Rom]Re:Zero Wiki[/url]]
